name: zakariye-digital-universe
description: The Lattice — cinematic 3D experience, API and admin for the Zakariye Digital Universe project.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @lattice/api && npm run build -w @lattice/web && npm run build -w @lattice/admin
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
